questions.q: According to 1 Peter 3:15, Christians are commanded to always be prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks for a reason for the hope they have. In what manner should this defense be made?
questions.explain: 1 Peter 3:15 highlights the proper Christian attitude towards non-believers: "always being prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you; yet do it with gentleness and respect."
